study type: Retrospective case series / Surgical experience review
cohort: 570 patients born with cloaca who were operated on by Dr. Alberto Pena and the author over an 8-year period.
finding: Benign cloaca, representing over 50% of cases, can be repaired with a reproducible surgical technique leading to good functional prognosis (bowel/urinary control, sexual activity, pregnancy), while complex cloaca requires highly specialized surgical repair.
mod_finding: Patients with repaired "benign" cloaca may get pregnant and deliver by cesarean section.
